name: TerraformDriftSurgeonV1
description: Runs terraform plan, detects drift and common module/resource conflicts, then generates terraform import / taint / state commands to realign state with Azure. Can optionally auto-apply drift fixes when requested via AUTO_APPLY_TERRAFORM_DRIFT=true.
initial_prompt:
Terraform Drift Surgeon v1 detects and fixes Terraform state drift:

1. Pre-flight — Runs terraform init and validate
2. Plan — Runs terraform plan with -detailed-exitcode to detect drift
3. Drift Parsing — Analyzes plan output for 'already exists', 'must be imported', and 'will be created' patterns
4. Auto-Fix Logic — Generates TERRAFORM_DRIFT_FIXES.md with import commands. If AUTO_APPLY_TERRAFORM_DRIFT=true, automatically runs terraform import commands
5. Terraform Apply — (orchestrate mode only) Applies the plan after drift fixes

Modes:
- orchestrate (default): Full pipeline with apply
- plan: Only detect drift, no apply
- auto-fix: Apply fixes automatically (gated by env var)

Called automatically by PrismaBuildSurgeonV5 on Terraform failures, but can also be run standalone.
